errors.text: The proposed kink-pair-controlled screw-dislocation mechanism is transferred primarily from a BCC MoNbTaW refractory HEA to an FCC FeNiCrMn alloy without system-specific evidence.
It misses the target onset mechanism: dislocation nucleation at vacancy clusters or disordered sites, followed by Shockley partial slip and stacking-fault formation.
The proposed strain-rate range of 10^-4 to 10^2 s^-1 does not reconstruct the molecular-dynamics regime of 10^8 to 10^10 s^-1.
It omits the required crystallographic loading directions and does not identify the strong orientation anisotropy, including maximum yield stress along <-111>.
The predicted smooth yielding transition conflicts with the abrupt stress drop associated with dislocation nucleation in the target result.
